about: Trigger cases for the unsupervised skill. should_trigger prompts must load it; should_not_trigger prompts are near misses that must not. check_skill.py guards the description's trigger list against the near misses; trigger_eval.py runs them in Claude Code.
should_trigger: Set up Architech in this repo.
I want to try Architech on my project, where do I start?
Hand this bug to Architech and tell me when the PR is up.
Run architech -p headless on this task and read the verdict back.
What's the difference between Full-Loop and Fast Mode in Architech?
Which Architech command should I use for a small bug fix?
Dispatch this issue to Architech in the background so it can still ask me questions.
Is Architech up to date? Check for an update.
Let Architech's agents build this unsupervised while I review the plan.
should_not_trigger: How do I do unsupervised clustering in sklearn?
Set up Helix to evaluate my LLM agent.
Compare k-means and DBSCAN for unsupervised anomaly detection.
Write a PCA example for dimensionality reduction.
Who is the architect on this project?
Design the system architecture for a payment service.
Run my test suite headless in CI.
Start a tmux session for my dev server.
Review this pull request for bugs.
